fields.statement: Verifier at 6937db290: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-start-queue$' -count=1 passed. The script sets rhiza.daemon.permissionMode=acceptEdits, queues rhiza run start --workflow plan --autonomous with no --permission-mode, asserts starts.json records no permission_mode, then rhiza daemon --once starts it and the script waits for a run journal recording "permission_mode":"acceptEdits" (a mode no earlier run used), closing review finding f1; with the setting unset or nonsense the queued start is refused (stderr names the setting / mode) and the unset case asserts nothing queued; --foreground gets no stand-in. Read the diff: queuedCheckMode (internal/api/run.go) feeds rhiza.daemon.permissionMode to both checkAgentSteps calls before queueRunStart, so a refusal writes nothing, and the queued start still records r.PermissionMode (empty); daemonQueuedStarts falls back to the daemon's mode; other checkAgentSteps callers re-check started runs whose journal holds the daemon's mode. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run 'TestQueuedCheckMode|TestRunStartAgentRefusals|TestDaemon' -count=1 passed, incl. TestQueuedCheckModeStandsInDaemonMode (queued gets the daemon's mode, named mode wins, foreground none).
